question: How many open claims does each North adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract) currently assigned to each adjuster in the North region (adjusters.region = 'North'), counted by the claims.adjuster_id field, which names the adjuster currently responsible. All 7 North adjusters are still employed.
report.answer: The 7 North adjusters hold 126 open claims in total. Jacqueline Smith (ADJ-023) has 22, Joshua Miller (ADJ-027) and Adam Sanchez (ADJ-024) have 20 each, Abigail Foster (ADJ-026) and Charles Robinson (ADJ-028) have 18 each, and Charles Price (ADJ-022) and Jamie Jones (ADJ-025) have 14 each. Recent claims are still being reported, so counts for the latest weeks may rise.
report.answer_sql: SELECT a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open') AS open_claims FROM adjusters a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id WHERE a.region='North' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY open_claims DESC

findings.claim: Open claims per North adjuster range from 14 to 22, 126 in total.
findings.evidence_sql: SELECT sum(open_claims) AS total_open, max(open_claims) AS max_open, min(open_claims) AS min_open FROM (SELECT count(*) AS open_claims FROM claims c JOIN adjusters a USING(adjuster_id) WHERE a.region='North' AND c.status='open' GROUP BY adjuster_id)
